messages:
SRE Bot: INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on inference-gateway-prod (region: eu-west-1). Alert: gateway.5xx_rate > 8% for 5m. Paging oncall @Alex :rotating_light:

Alex: I'm on it. Acknowledge. Starting triage.

Maya: looking at dashboards — 502 and 504 spike across gateway and edge-proxy, latencies also up. Last deploy ~21m ago (deploy id d-8792).

Samir: throwing up quick query: `sum(rate(http_responses_total{code=~"5..",service=~"(gateway|edge-proxy)"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{service=~"(gateway|edge-proxy)"}[5m]))` — shows 9.3% 5xx for gateway.

Nyla: I'm checking router logs for inference-router. Seeing `error upstream reset` and `context deadline exceeded` for requests > 2.5s. Prefix cache evictions jumped.

Alex: any error signatures? paste sample logs.

Maya: sample from gateway: ```json
{"ts":"2026-08-12T14:17:32Z","level":"error","msg":"upstream 502","route":"/v1/generate","trace":"trace-0a4f"}``` also `rpc: deadline exceeded` from inference-hosts.

Samir: traffic distribution: 60% to primary GPU pool (p-1), 35% to p-2, 5% to fallback (cpu). p-1 pod restarts increased. Could be OOMs or bad kernel.

Alex: priority actions: 1) divert new requests away from p-1 (reduce weight), 2) increase capacity on p-2, 3) enable short-circuit fallback for requests >3s. Maya/Nyla take 1/2. Samir tune routing. Lia, gather customer-facing impact.

Maya: applying weight shift to routing policy: `curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/v1/routing -d '{"pools":{"p-1":20,"p-2":60,"fallback":20}}'` -> 202 Accepted. Watch metrics.

Nyla: scaling p-2 by +3 nodes (manual) and increasing pod replica target. K8s command: `kubectl scale --replicas=6 deploy/inference-worker-p2 -n prod`.

DeployBot: rollback triggered for deploy d-8792 by Alex (reason: correlated failure). Rollback started, will post status.

Samir: enabled short-circuit fallback (drop long-running KV/stream ops) with temporary circuit-breaker config. Patch: `circuit.max_duration_ms=3000`.

Maya: 5xx rate dropping to 4.1% within 3m after routing change + scale. Good signal.

Lia: we have 3 open customer tickets (enterprise) reporting degraded generation timeouts in EU. Escalated to account owners, no financial SLA breaches reported yet. Informing CS.

Alex: continuing to monitor. If rollback completes cleanly and 5xx < 1% for 10m, we'll page down. Keep oncall channel updated.

(10m later)

DeployBot: rollback complete for d-8792 -> active revision d-8788. All gateways report healthy.

Maya: 5xx stabilized at 0.6% over last 10m, p-1 pod restarts stopped. Looks like faulty kernel+alloc combo on d-8792.

Nyla: noticed increased prefix cache evictions were contributing to tail latencies. Need short-term: reduce cache TTLs to avoid large eviction spikes. Will open follow-up.

Alex: declaring incident: mitigated (P1 -> monitoring). We need immediate post-incident actions: hotfix, runbook updates, alert tuning, and customer comms.

Samir: hotfix idea: add an automated pre-deploy health check for kernel-level alloc metrics and an exponential-burn-in traffic ramp for new pool versions. I'll draft PR.

Maya: runbook gaps: current runbook doesn't include a traffic weight quick-shift snippet or the exact circuit-breaker knob names. I'll update.

Lia: customer impact summary for internal comms: "EU customers experienced elevated 5xx/timeouts between 2026-08-12T14:15Z and 2026-08-12T14:40Z. Root cause: bad rollout (d-8792) causing increased restarts and cache evictions. Mitigation: rollback to d-8788 and routing weight shift. No SLA credits expected; CS to monitor for complaints."

Alex: action items (assigning):
- Samir: PR for pre-deploy alloc checks + CI gating (owner: Samir) — due EOD tomorrow.
- Maya: update incident runbook with traffic-shift commands, circuit-breaker names, and cache TTL knobs (owner: Maya) — due EOD today.
- Nyla: create alert rule for cache-eviction-rate and add a sub-threshold alert at 1% evictions/m for 3m (owner: Nyla) — due tomorrow morning.
- Lia: draft customer status note and CS playbook (owner: Lia) — due in 2 hours.
- Alex: postmortem writeup + link telemetry (owner: Alex) — due 48h.

Maya: quick notes to include in runbook: `curl` snippet for weight shift, `kubectl scale` snippet, and path to rollback command in DeployBot.

Samir: alert tuning suggestion: change gateway.5xx_rate alert from static 5% to an adaptive threshold based on request volume + add a sliding-window suppress for deploy windows (30m). I'll put proposal in PR.

Nyla: I'll schedule a short follow-up sync tomorrow 11:00 UTC to review root cause and infra changes. Calendar invite incoming.

Lia: customer note drafted: "We're investigating a transient issue impacting inference requests in EU. We've mitigated the issue by reverting a recent rollout and applying traffic controls. We'll follow up with a detailed postmortem." Posting to affected accounts now.

Alex: handoff to next oncall (Samir) in 40m. Current state: mitigated, monitoring, monitoring alerts reduced. If anything regresses, page SRE immediately.

Samir: acknowledged. I'll be on secondary watch.

Alex: thanks team :thumbsup: — closing live thread, will link postmortem here when ready.
